title: Barbeiro
description: Realize atendimentos de lavagem de cabelos, escova lisa, escova modelada e babyliss pela empresa Bluma. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a empresa oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificados(as). É importante também não estar vinculada a benefícios sociais, como Bolsa Família, BPC ou similares, já que a formalização como MEI implica na perda desses benefícios.

Descrição da vaga:

Ofereça os seus serviços de garçom para hotéis através da b2bhotel. Você tem flexibilidade para escolher os seus horários de trabalho e quais serviços deseja realizar. O controle da sua agenda é feito de forma online e os pagamentos são feitos semanalmente, de acordo com os serviços realizados naquela semana.


O que preciso para me aplicar?

Possuir MEI,

Possuir ao menos 3 meses de experiência comprovada na área,

Possuir ao menos 1 referência de hotel onde tenha trabalhado.

title: Manicure
description:
Realize atendimentos de Manicure, Pedicure e Spa dos pés. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que você mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Os atendimento serão realizados em estabelecimentos da Bluma localizados em aeroportos.
Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a Bluma oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificadas.

title: RippleX Partner Director
description:
At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.

If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Are you a strategic leader with deep experience in relationship management and a passion for tokenization, institutional finance, and blockchain technology? As a Partner Director on the RippleX Partner Success team, you'll play a key role in accelerating the growth and impact of the XRPL ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of high-profile partners—including financial institutions, fintechs, and crypto-native builders—guiding them through every stage of their journey: from idea to integration to go-live and scale.

This is not a passive role. You will be hands-on in shaping tokenization strategies, architecting utility on-chain, and removing roadblocks in dynamic, high-stakes environments. Your day-to-day will span deep technical discussions and executive-level strategic planning—always with the goal of maximizing partner success and driving meaningful, on-ledger activity.

If you're excited to unlock real-world utility through tokenized assets and thrive at the intersection of institutional finance and blockchain innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Own and lead a portfolio of highly strategic and complex Institutional DeFi partners building on XRPL, with a focus on scaled adoption of tokenized asset use cases.
  • Define and drive strategic account plans that maximize long-term value for both Ripple and its partners.
  • Lead execution across technical and GTM workstreams, anticipating risks and aligning cross-functional resources to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Provide thought leadership and guidance to partners around tokenization, utility, regulatory considerations, and financial market structures.
  • Build and maintain strong executive relationships with C-level stakeholders at partner organizations, and act as a senior voice across Ripple internal teams.
  • Represent partner needs and priorities internally, influencing RippleX's roadmap, product strategy, and go-to-market motions.
  • Identify opportunities for broader ecosystem impact and partner cross-collaboration to accelerate XRPL utility.
  • Travel to partner and customer sites as needed (20–30%).

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • 10–12+ years of experience leading strategic partnerships or enterprise engagements in fintech, financial services, or blockchain—ideally with a focus on innovation and emerging tech.
  • Institutional Finance Acumen: Deep understanding of financial instruments and market structure (equities, bonds, repos, collateralized lending, etc.). Strong grasp of collateral management, capital efficiency, and how DeFi can impact these processes. Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (Basel III, MiFID, EMIR, etc.) and how they relate to tokenisation and digital asset adoption
  • Tokenization Expertise: Strong command of tokenization models, use cases, and best practices. Able to influence strategy and guide partner implementation across the asset lifecycle.
  • Blockchain Fluency: Deep understanding of blockchain fundamentals and how they can be applied to financial use cases such as tokenization, settlement, and collateral management. Ability to evaluate different protocol features (e.g., scalability, finality, cost, security) and articulate how they impact institutional DeFi applications. Experience advising on interoperability protocols and bridging technologies (e.g., Axelar) to support cross-chain integration and ecosystem connectivity.
  • Go-to-Market & Utility Creation: Proven track record of launching scalable GTM strategies that result in sustained on-chain activity and partner adoption. Ability to cross-pollinate within Ripple and across partners.
  • Partner Enablement & Growth: Extensive experience leading strategic partnerships and enterprise relationships, with a focus on enabling partners from ideation through to build, compliance readiness, and scaled deployment. Adept at managing complex stakeholder dynamics across technical, product, and executive functions. Proven ability to proactively remove obstacles and shape partner strategy to drive momentum, unlock long-term value, and deliver measurable impact on ecosystem growth.
  • Problem Solving with Agency: Bias for action and proactive problem solving, especially when navigating ambiguity or institutional inertia. Strong "ownership mindset" to help partners go from idea to deployment with confidence. Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset—skilled at managing through ambiguity, resolving friction, and anticipating downstream impact.
  • Executive Presence & Trust Building: Experienced engaging at the C-suite level at tier 1 banks and asset managers, with credibility, empathy, and strategic insight. Trusted advisor in high-stakes conversations. Skilled in managing sensitive conversations (regulatory risk, commercial conflicts, etc.).
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Comfortable driving alignment and influencing roadmaps across multiple internal teams to ensure success at scale.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. Please find our UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice and our California Applicant Privacy Notice for reference.

title: Vendedor
description:
A Baggio Café, uma das marcas de café mais premiadas do Brasil, está em busca de um(a) Vendedor(a) Externo(a) para atuar em São Paulo (Grande São Paulo, Litoral e Baixada Santista), com foco em redes de supermercados premium e contas estratégicas.

Buscamos um profissional com visão comercial, bom relacionamento no mercado e experiência sólida na indústria de alimentos.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão e desenvolvimento de carteira de clientes premium, com foco em redes de supermercados e empórios
  • Abertura de novas contas e expansão de mix nos clientes ativos
  • Negociação comercial, acompanhamento de pedidos e execução de ações no ponto de venda
  • Interface com áreas internas (trade, marketing, logística e financeiro)
  • Monitoramento de preços, concorrência e oportunidades de mercado
  • Garantir execução de marca alinhada ao posicionamento premium da Baggio Café

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada como vendedor(a) externo(a) na indústria de alimentos
  • Vivência no atendimento a redes de supermercados premium
  • Carteira de clientes ativa na região de São Paulo
  • Forte habilidade de negociação e relacionamento
  • Perfil organizado, autônomo e orientado a resultados
  • Veículo próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamento

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com produtos premium ou marcas de valor agregado
  • Conhecimento do mercado de cafés, bebidas ou alimentos especiais
  • Vivência em negociações com redes regionais e contas-chave

title: Consultor de Governança
description:
Buscamos um profissional para liderar a estruturação e a manutenção do nosso ecossistema de dados. O foco principal será a implementação e gestão do Unity Catalog, estabelecendo políticas de governança que garantam a segurança, conformidade e qualidade dos dados utilizados em modelos de Analytics e Inteligência Artificial.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Gestão de Unity Catalog: Configurar e administrar o Unity Catalog (Databricks) para garantir o controle de acesso centralizado (lineage, permissões e auditoria).
  • Políticas de Governança: Desenvolver e implementar políticas de governança de dados e IA, garantindo que o ciclo de vida dos dados esteja em conformidade com normas (como LGPD) e boas práticas de mercado.

  • Habilidade excepcional em escrita técnica e documentação.

Diferenciais

Perfil Desejado (Soft Skills)

title: Audio Producer II
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

About the position:

We are seeking an experienced and driven Audio Producer II with a background in audio production workflows. This role involves cross-functional collaboration, and managing external partnerships to deliver exceptional audio experiences. This role will provide hands-on support in voice-over production tasks, music editing, and operational processes, ensuring smooth workflows between the audio team, internal, and external partners.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in voice-over production tasks, including communicating with vendors and internal local teams.
  • Communicate with internal and external partners to identify audio needs, plan execution, and ensure alignment from pre-production to delivery, acting as a key point of contact for audio-related matters.
  • Participate in the development of music, sound effects, and voice-over production schedules, ensuring alignment with multidisciplinary planning and vendor timelines.
  • Create comprehensive briefings for audio outsourcing partners, providing all necessary creative, technical, and production information.
  • Create, edit, and implement sound effects, voice-over assets, and other audio deliverables.

title: Consultor(a) de Vendas - Loja Física Campinas
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)
Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.
O Perfil que Buscamos:
Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados, que enxerga cada cliente como uma oportunidade única de encantamento. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia na loja, buscando atingir suas metas, e a criatividade para criar experiências memoráveis para o consumidor, dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.
Características que nos inspiram: • Mentalidade analítica: Usa o perfil do cliente para fundamentar decisões criativas na venda. • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo da loja (metas, estoque, cliente) antes de agir. • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente sobre novos rótulos e se reinventa conforme o fluxo de clientes. • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades do cliente e propõe soluções (harmonizações, presentes). • Resiliência: Transforma um "não" ou um desafio (um cliente que não sabe o que quer) em uma oportunidade de fidelização.
Descrição do Cargo:
O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas é a pessoa fundamental para conectar nosso portfólio de vinhos ao cliente final. Ele(a) é a "cara" da Zahil na loja, responsável por traduzir a complexidade e a história de cada garrafa em uma linguagem acessível e encantadora. É preciso ter agilidade para entender o que o cliente busca (muitas vezes, sem ele saber dizer), flexibilidade para navegar entre diferentes perfis de consumidores e uma vontade de aprender constantemente. Sua função é transformar o atendimento consultivo em resultados de vendas, fidelizando clientes e garantindo o bom funcionamento da loja.
Responsabilidades:
• Prestar atendimento consultivo de excelência, identificando o perfil de gosto, ocasião e orçamento de cada cliente. • Analisar o perfil do cliente e apresentar os vinhos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença na sua experiência. • Apoiar ativamente na prospecção de novos clientes na loja, assim como realizar "follow up" e pós-venda para clientes cadastrados. • Acompanhar as metas de vendas individuais e da loja (resultados, positivações) e propor ações para atingi-las. • Organizar e acompanhar degustações, "mini feiras" e eventos na loja, analisando o retorno de cada ação. • Garantir a organização do salão de vendas, incluindo reposição de produtos, precificação e Visual Merchandising. • Manter-se informado sobre todas as comunicações da Zahil, chegada de produtos, mudanças de preços, promoções e novas tabelas de trabalho. • Transmitir à gerência da loja as dificuldades, demandas dos clientes ou oportunidades de melhoria percebidas no dia a dia. • Apoiar no uso do sistema interno de faturamento da loja, CRM e no cadastro de clientes.
Qualificações e Experiência
• Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa ou curso técnico. • Cursos: Curso de vinhos (técnico ou de extensão) é um forte diferencial. • Idiomas: Desejável inglês e/ou espanhol (para atendimento a clientes estrangeiros). • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de dois anos em atendimento ao cliente e vendas(varejo). • Desejável: Experiência prévia no setor de vinhos (lojas, empórios, restaurantes).
Remuneração: • Regime CLT: R$ 3.000,00 (três mil reais) de salário fixo + comissão mensal
Benefícios: Vale Refeição/Alimentação, Vale Mobilidade Plano médico

Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.

Por que um Banco de Talentos afirmativo para Pessoas com Deficiência?

Na Atos, acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho baseado na equidade, inclusão e diversidade. Por isso, incentivamos que todas as pessoas se inscrevam diretamente nas vagas de interesse.

No entanto, se no momento você não encontrou uma posição alinhada ao seu perfil, pode compartilhar seu currículo conosco por meio do nosso Banco de Talentos dedicado a pessoas com deficiência. Nosso Banco de Talentos é uma forma de conectar profissionais qualificados a futuras oportunidades em diversas áreas da nossa organização.

Nossa equipe de Talent Acquisition analisará os perfis cadastrados e poderá entrar em contato conforme novas oportunidades surgirem. Destacamos que os candidatos serão considerados para todas as áreas de atuação dentro da empresa.

title: Analista de Remuneração e Benefícios Sênior
description:
Como Analista de Remuneração e Benefícios Sênior, atuará de forma estratégica na estruturação, análise e governança das práticas de remuneração Fixa e Variável, garantindo equidade interna, competitividade externa e sustentabilidade do budget, apoiando as decisões de liderança e a estratégia do negócio.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir e manter a estrutura de cargos, salários e níveis da companhia (job architecture).

  • Atuar como ponto focal técnico para processos de mérito, promoção, enquadramento salarial e movimentações.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o budget de remuneração (mérito, promoções, ajustes e dissídios).

  • Conhecimento sólido em estratégias e metodologias de consultorias (ex.: Mercer, Korn Ferry, Radford, Willis Towers Watson ou similares) e entendero concento
  • Apoiar a construção e revisão de programas de remuneração variável (PLR, bônus, incentivos de curto e longo prazo).
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto aos HRBPs e lideranças, apoiando tomadas de decisão.
  • Criar análises, relatórios e dashboards com indicadores de remuneração.
  • Experiência na construção, acompanhamento e análise de KPIs de RH, como turnover, headcount, absenteísmo, produtividade, custo de pessoal, SLA e indicadores de eficiência operacional
  • Garantir compliance com legislação trabalhista, práticas de governança e auditorias internas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em People Analytics, com capacidade de estruturar, analisar e interpretar dados de pessoas.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Psicologia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Pessoas, Remuneração, Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas afins (desejável).
  • Excel avançado (modelagem financeira, tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas, simulações e cenários).
  • Ferramentas de People Analytics e BI (Power BI, Tableau ou similares – desejável).
  • Sistema Scorb.
  • Sistemas de gestão de RH / HCM: Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, ADP ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de controle de budget e planejamento financeiro (Excel, ERP, FP&A).

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It's Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.

About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound's Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies' renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report).

About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing "start-up" within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.

We expect East work hours.

As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You have advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you

What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN's business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN's market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN's various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.

In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN's corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.

Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN's commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN's senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN's market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN's network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN's market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company's overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management's reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.

  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional experience in C# and Angular or React.js to support the development, migration, and ongoing evolution of a platform. This role will play a key part in delivering new product initiatives, maintaining existing systems, and implementing a modernized architecture across multiple verticals.

The ideal candidate is technically strong across the stack, comfortable working within an established architectural vision, and proactive in taking ownership of implementation and delivery.

Our U.S. client is a fast-growing, mission-driven language technology company developing the next generation of interpretation and multilingual communication platforms. Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI powering solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines. The company has consistently achieved Net Promoter Scores (NPS) above 60, reflecting excellent customer satisfaction. The team is collaborative, inclusive, and highly engaged, with strong onboarding and growth support for new hires.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack features across web applications and backend services
  • Implement solutions aligned with architectural guidance provided by the architecture team
  • Contribute to the development of new products while maintaining and enhancing existing systems
  • Support the migration of legacy components into a modern microservices-based architecture
  • Build and maintain scalable backend services using C#, .NET, and SQL
  • Develop and maintain front-end functionality using Angular, with the
  • ability to quickly learn and adapt as needed
  • Collaborate across multiple product verticals and support a growing pipeline of new initiatives
  • Take technical ownership of assigned areas, leading implementation efforts and driving work forward
  • Partner closely with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to deliver on the broader technical vision

Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a software engineer in a full-stack capacity
  • Strong backend experience with C#, .NET, and SQL
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining microservices-based systems
  • Front-end development experience, ideally with Angular, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Experience working within an established architecture and implementing designs created by an architecture team
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work across multiple projects and verticals
  • Proactive, energetic mindset with a willingness to take ownership and lead by example

Preferred Experience

  • Experience participating in large-scale system migrations or platform modernization efforts
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments and distributed systems
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments with multiple concurrent initiatives

Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL

BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.

Our mission is to transform people's lives for the better. We don't hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.

Our message to the world is simple – make everyone's life healthier and longer with help of BGI.

Why joining us?

Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.

Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.

Why do we want you?

We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI's values, products and services. And that's why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.

Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:

1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.

Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:

1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.

Competences:

a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.

Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners' physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.

Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.

· What do we offer?

1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.

Let's move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall

title: Consultor de Vendas
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a "verem mais e serem mais" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.

  • Realiza a visitação presencial com maletas contendo todo o mostruário da marca e tablet digital
  • Gerir a carteira de clientes.
  • Gestão de relacionamento com a manutenção e fidelização dos clientes
  • Prospecção e fechamento de propostas para novos clientes
  • Monitoramento da concorrência e suas ações no mercado.
  • Alimentação e análise e indicadores.
  • Trabalhar com rotas e metas mensais.
  • Responsável pelo fechamento da venda e retirada dos pedidos.
  • Realiza negociações e implementações de ações de Trade Marketing nos PDVs.
  • Atuação com vendas externas em todo o MG e DF com base em BH.

-Nível superior completo

-Experiência em venda externa com foco em sellin e sell out no varejo.

-Profissional com experiência no mercado esportivo será um diferencial

-CNH B.

description:

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior
description:
A Brunel está em busca de uma Analista de Recursos Humanos Sênior (com foco em benefícios) para atuar em um contrato indeterminado junto a um de nossos clientes no setor de petróleo e gás! O regime de trabalho será de 40 horas semanais, em regime presencial, alocado no escritório do Rio de Janeiro (RJ).

Atividades:

  • Gestão operacional e transacional de benefícios, incluindo assistência médica e odontológica, vale-refeição, vale-alimentação, vale-transporte, cartão mobilidade, cartão de natal, estacionamento, previdência privada, seguro de vida, auxílio creche/babá, wellhub, PAE, auxílio farmácia, loyalty awards, check-up executivo e programas financeiros.

  • Experiência sólida (nível sênior) em administração de benefícios.

  • Conhecimento de interface com fornecedores de benefícios.
  • Forte domínio de controles operacionais, relatórios e indicadores.
  • Conhecimento de ACT e impactos em benefícios.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado (planilhas de controle, consolidações e relatórios).
  • Perfil organizado, analítico, com atenção a detalhes e foco em prazos.
  • Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos benefícios simultaneamente.

title: Tax Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil ("CSBR") is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan's largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Tax Calculation & Compliance:

  • Expertise in the calculation and review of all major federal taxes: IRPJ/CSLL (Annual/Quarterly Actual Profit Lucro Real and Presumed Profit Lucro Presumido), and PIS/COFINS (Cumulative and Non-Cumulative regimes).
  • Deep knowledge of federal withholding taxes (IRRF, CSRF, INSSRF) and their accounting reconciliation.
  • Experience with tax benefits and fiscal incentives + Tax Credits.

Auxiliary Obligations

  • Extensive experience in the preparation, review, and timely submission of federal and state Tax obligations, including: DCTF, ECF, EFD Contributions, EFD Reinf, ECD, Per/Dcomp, GIA, SPED Fiscal,E-financeira, Dimp.

Tax Credits & Recovery:

  • Proven track record in identifying and processing tax credits, including claims for undue or overpayment, IRPJ/CSLL negative balances, and PIS/COFINS credits (Restitution and Reimbursement requests).

Audit & Litigation Support

  • Experience managing the Tax Audit calendar and serving as the primary point of contact for external audits.
  • Ability to analyze and respond to official notices, subpoenas (intimações), decision-making orders (despachos decisórios), and internal preliminary tax reviews from the Brazilian Federal Revenue (Receita Federal do Brasil).

Tax Planning & Strategy:

  • Knowledge of Transfer Pricing (specifically for Services) and the ability to act as a Tax Business Partner to internal controls (risk management) and international finance teams (supporting international expansion, and local registration,).
  • Financial Reconciliation: Advanced skill in performing detailed fiscal cross-checks (ECF x EFD Contribuições x DCTF x Apurações x DARFs) and reconciling tax-related general ledger accounts (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IRRF, PCC).
  • Collaboration & Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative attitude, focused on sharing knowledge, working effectively in a team environment, and ensuring effective internal customer service.

Requirements

  • Over 10 years of progressive experience in the fiscal and tax field, with expertise gained across diverse sectors including: Technology/Services and Finance.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Law and specialization/Post-Graduate certification in Taxation.
  • Advanced proficiency and practical expertise in leading ERP systems
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese & English (both verbal and written)
  • Able to commute to the office in Sao Paulo a few times a week
  • Knowledge in Brazilian Tax regulation
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel
  • Well-rounded understanding and mindset in corporate governance pertaining to Brazilian central Bank

Preferred Competencies:

  • Process Automation & Design: Experience in the automation of tax and P2P processes (invoice receipt, payment, tax calculation, and ancillary obligations) and in the mapping/design of corporate tax processes and policies.
  • Project Management & Coordination: Demonstrated ability to manage complex tax projects, coordinate team activities, and monitor performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.g. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Assistente Administrativo - Compras
description:
Que bom que você está aqui!

Integridade, paixão pela excelência, trabalho em equipe, respeito e cuidado, espírito empreendedor e foco no cliente são os valores que guiam nossas ações há todo momento.

Se você quer trabalhar em uma equipe que valoriza o trabalho conjunto e o desejo de fazer a diferença, a MedQuímica é o lugar certo para você. Junte-se a nós, na batida de um só coração.

Sobre a vaga:

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Receber, organizar e processar as requisições de compra no sistema SAP (Módulo MM), verificando a correta especificação, centro de custo e aprovações necessárias;

- Criar e emitir ordens de compra (POs) no SAP, garantindo que todas as informações (preço, prazo de entrega, condições de pagamento) estejam corretas e alinhadas com o negociado;

- Acompanhar ativamente os prazos de entrega junto aos fornecedores, comunicando proativamente qualquer desvio ou potencial atraso para a equipe e os requisitantes;

- Organizar e arquivar documentos essenciais do processo de compra, como cotações, contratos de baixo valor e confirmações de pedido, garantindo a rastreabilidade e a conformidade (compliance);

- Apoiar na manutenção do cadastro de fornecedores e materiais no sistema, assegurando a acuracidade das informações;

- Extrair dados do SAP para gerar relatórios simples de acompanhamento, como status de pedidos abertos, performance de entrega, etc.

Requisitos e qualificações:

- Cursando ensino superior em Administração, Logística ou Comércio Exterior;

- Desejável conhecimento em ERP de preferência SAP;

- Experiência prévia em atividades administrativas na área de compras em indústria farmacêutica,

química ou de cosméticos será um diferencial.

Na Amaris Consulting, promovemos um ambiente inclusivo e valorizamos a diversidade. Todas as candidaturas são consideradas sem distinção de gênero, origem, religião, orientação sexual, deficiência ou idade.

  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office, com ênfase em Excel ou Power BI;

title: Analista de Finanças e Operações
description:
Resumo da posição

Tipo de contratação: CLT

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Finanças e Operações (Pleno) para assumir, com autonomia, a operação de NF-e (entrada, saída/venda e importação) e rotinas financeiras operacionais que suportam faturamento, conformidade e fechamento. É uma vaga de execução com método: checklist, evidências e rastreabilidade, com escalonamento apenas por exceção.

Responsabilidades

NF-e e faturamento (ponta a ponta)

  • Emissão de NF-e de saída/venda (faturamento): emissão, autorização, correções, reemissões e rotinas associadas (cancelamento/CC-e quando aplicável).

  • Operação de NF-e ligada à importação: emissão e/ou conferência operacional com base em DI/DUIMP, Invoice, Packing List e despesas acessórias (no nível necessário para suportar emissão e consistência documental).

Operações financeiras (Finance Ops)

  • Pré-processamento de pagamentos: coleta/validação de documentos suporte, organização de evidências e checagem de aprovações para execução pelo responsável final.
  • Classificação de transações conforme COA gerencial e padrões internos.
  • Gestão de pendências/missing payments (follow-up, status e reprocessos).
  • Apoio ao fechamento operacional: organização de pastas do período, evidências, checklists e amarrações básicas.

Controles e consistência (nível operacional)

  • Controles e conciliações operacionais entre NF-e movimentos/estoque registros contábeis (quando aplicável ao processo).
  • Organização de bases de controle (Excel/SharePoint) com disciplina de data quality (campos críticos, duplicidades e completude).
Requisitos (obrigatórios)
  • Experiência prática com emissão de NF-e de saída/venda (faturamento) e NF-e de entrada.
  • Experiência prática em NF-e ligada à importação (emissão ou conferência operacional com DI/DUIMP).
  • Excel sólido e disciplina de checklist/controle documental.

Diferenciais
  • Rotina completa de correções: devoluções, remessas, bonificações e ajustes (quando aplicável).
  • Vivência com cadastros mínimos que suportam emissão (ex.: NCM/CFOP por cenário e parâmetros essenciais).
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados e com alta exigência de rastreabilidade documental.

title: Especialista em Planejamento de Mina (Ventilaçao)
description:
Especialista em Planejamento de Mina (Foco: Ventilação)
Excelente oportunidade para uma pessoa qualificada e com experiência na área de planejamento de mina, foco em ventilação.
A empresa
Nosso cliente é uma das maiores produtoras de ouro do mundo em atuação no país.
A posição
Em um ambiente de mineração subterrânea onde a ventilação é o pilar fundamental da segurança e produtividade, você terá o desafio de conduzir o planejamento estratégico de sistemas de ventilação e refrigeração de minas subterrâneas. Essa posição exige expertise técnica para assegurar que a disciplina esteja em acordo com normas regulatórias e padrões internos. Trata-se de uma oportunidade única de planejar sistemas de ventilação de alta complexidade em minerações profundas. Suas decisões contribuirão diretamente em assegurar um ambiente de trabalho confortável e seguro para os times operacionais.
Responsabilidades
Como especialista no tema, você será responsável por dimensionar e operacionalizar sistemas de ventilação que sustentem as operações de frentes de trabalho em acordo com o planejamento anual e estratégico de produção. Suas atribuições também incluem colaboração no design da mina, participação em projetos e comitês de emergência, execução de tarefas técnicas, com foco em resultados práticos e conformidade:
  • Simulação e Modelagem: Empregar softwares como Deswik, Ventsim para simulações termodinâmicas do fluxo de ar na mina, incluindo cenários de produção, dimensionamento de frota, geotermia bem como cenários de emergência. Validar os modelos com dados reais para assegurar a calibração do modelo.
  • Integração com Planos de Produção e Lavra: Analisar impactos básicos da ventilação em planos de lavra, desenvolvimento, sondagem e infraestrutura, colaborando com as diferentes áreas e assegurar resposta a variações operacionais. Ser o guardião dos padrões internos, assegurando equilíbrio entre segurança e metas de produção.
  • Conformidade com Normas Regulamentadoras: Garantir adesão às normas principais, como NR-22, ABNT NBR 16401, padrões internos da companhia, realizando revisões regulares e melhorias nos padrões.
  • Gestão de Perdas e Recirculações: Identificar perdas de ar através de inspeções em campo com instrumentos de medição, propor estratégias para reduzir recirculações, perdas. Interagir com as diversas disciplinas para construção do sequenciamento de atividades para melhorar a eficiência.
  • Melhoria de qualidade das instalações de ventilação: Desenvolver soluções com foco em melhores materiais, métodos ou tecnologias que assegurem a conformidade das vedações das estruturas que compõe o sistema de ventilação.
Requisitos
É essencial que o profissional possua as seguintes habilidades e qualificações:
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia (Minas, Mecânica, Elétrica ou Civil) com CREA ativo.
  • Especialização: Conhecimentos em aerodinâmica básica de minas, segurança subterrânea e princípios de sistemas de ar, com interesse em certificações em ventilação.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Familiaridade com softwares de planejamento de minas (ex.: Deswik, Datamine) e ventilação (ex.: Ventsim). Elaboração de apresentações executivas. Análise estatística de dados. Compreensão de normas técnicas nacionais.
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 4 anos em mineração subterrânea, com pelo menos 2 anos em atividades relacionadas a ventilação de minas subterrâneas. Experiência em projetos de média escala, incluindo monitoramento e ajustes operacionais.
Requisitos Desejáveis
  • Habilidades interpessoais para trabalho em equipe e poder de negociação.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com times internacionais e compreensão de bibliografia técnica.
  • Pós-Graduação na área de Ventilação ou Engenharia de Minas;

A empresa proporcionará um pacote atrativo de remuneração e benefícios.

description:

  • Realizar avaliação técnica e calibração de equipamentos novos antes da entrega ou instalação.

title: Senior Marketing Designer
description:
About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind—making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15-30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants. We help brands discover what actually converts—should luxury skincare shoppers see lifestyle photos or close-up texture shots? Does a supplement brand's product page convert better with per-serving or per-bottle pricing? These decisions matter, and we make it simple to find the answers through visual editors, AI-powered recommendations, and expert guidance.

We're scaling rapidly with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores, from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of less than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners—handpicked by Shopify themselves and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

What sets us apart isn't just our product—it's our world-class partnerships team (deeply embedded with the Shopify ecosystem and Shopify Platinum tech and agency partners) and our customer success organization that ensures brands actually get value from testing. We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem—not just a vendor.

As we accelerate growth, we're expanding our already-strong revenue organization. You'll have direct impact on our trajectory, real ownership over your book of business, and the chance to refine how we execute at scale.

We're a team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.

The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer at Shoplift, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the high-quality lead magnets, ad templates, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters—not through words, but through compelling visuals that show, don't tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2B SaaS marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert prospects into customers.

Here's what makes this role unique: We're a B2B SaaS company that doesn't take itself too seriously—our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the SaaS. Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, which is one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance here: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps this balance.

The creative challenge? We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2C marketers in the world—the people running growth at brands like KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work when they see it because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by the idea of "brand recognizes brand" and want to create marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams to surface the stories and data that make our marketing materials resonate.

What You'll Do

Marketing Creative & Campaign Assets

  • Design static ad templates for Meta, LinkedIn, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll
  • Create lead magnets (ebooks, guides, one-pagers) that look premium and convert
  • Build comparison visuals (before/after, without Shoplift vs. with Shoplift) that make value instantly clear
  • Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels
  • Create templated creative systems that can be adapted for different campaigns while maintaining brand consistency

Brand & Sales Materials

  • Create feature landing page designs that follow "show-don't-tell" philosophy
  • Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials
  • Design email headers, presentation templates, and other recurring brand assets
  • Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product Marketing Visualization

  • Design product marketing materials that highlight the excellence of the app
  • Create motion graphics and other dynamic visuals for various web mediums
  • Build a library of reusable marketing assets that maintain visual consistency

You'll contribute immediately—creating assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

You're a Great Fit If...

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2B SaaS portfolio
  • Expert-level Figma proficiency—you build organized, scalable systems
  • You understand brand nuance—the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic
  • Template-based thinking—you create assets others can adapt and reuse
  • English proficiency for daily collaboration with US-based team
  • Portfolio demonstrating marketing design work that shows personality and sophistication (applications without portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools
  • Motion design or animation skills
  • Performance marketing background (you understand what makes ads convert)
  • You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention

You'll thrive if you:

  • Get excited by the challenge of marketing to marketers—people who recognize great work
  • Can take a brief and run with it without extensive art direction
  • Work well asynchronously across time zones
  • Move fast, iterate based on feedback, and don't take revisions personally
  • Care about business outcomes, not just beautiful design
  • Appreciate brand personality and aren't afraid to push creative boundaries (within reason)

What We Offer

Salary: $45,000 - $55,000 USD annually

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work
  • Generous time off policy
  • Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand
  • Build your portfolio with high-quality B2B SaaS work that stands out
  • Collaborate with our product designer (also Brazil-based) on maintaining design consistency

How to Apply

Applications without a portfolio submitted through this link won't be considered:

When submitting you'll be asked to include:

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
Position: Senior Cost Controller

Location: Barra da Tijuca

About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.

Job Purpose

The Senior Cost Controller is responsible for ensuring accurate financial control, cost management, and compliance across business units, supporting operational performance and strategic decision-making, particularly within FPSO operations.

Key Responsibilities

Manage accounts receivable processes, including aging reports and timely customer collections;

Ensure accurate and timely posting of invoices and revenue entries;

Manage billing processes, ensuring charges are issued in accordance with signed contracts and agreements;

Ensure compliance with Brazilian withholding tax regulations and statutory requirements;

Support month-end and year-end closing activities;

Prepare and review monthly accruals and revenue reconciliations;

Review, analyze, and explain variances in monthly and quarterly management and vessel reports (ERP);

Ensure timely and reliable financial closing and statutory reporting;

Maintain, review, and improve accounting procedures, processes, and internal controls;

Ensure group reporting meets corporate, audit, and tax compliance requirements;

Liaise with operations and provide finance/accounting support to business units;

Resolve accounting and financial queries and support cross-functional activities as needed.

Requirements

Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience in FPSO or offshore oil & gas operations;

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related fields;

Fluent English;

Strong knowledge of financial controls, cost management, and Brazilian tax legislation;

Experience with IFS ERP is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance

Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds, including women, Bl.

description:

title: Executivo de contas
description:
Somos a Revenda Mais, uma empresa apaixonada por simplificar a gestão no segmento automotivo. Nosso compromisso é ajudar revendas de veículos em todo o país a prosperar, oferecendo soluções inteligentes que tornam a operação mais eficiente e econômica.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora SR (Oracle Forms e Reports) | Atacadão

Estamos investindo fortemente na simplificação e na aceleração digital, pois acreditamos que esse é o caminho para nos transformar e sermos protagonistas da mudança que queremos ver no país.

Trabalhar no Grupo Carrefour Brasil é participar diariamente de tudo isso, em um ambiente que respeita e acolhe as diferenças com muito espaço para crescer e aprender. Somos muitos e queremos ser ainda mais.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Teltonika IoT Solutions Brazil is a representative branch of Teltonika IoT Group, which has been creating and manufacturing Internet of Things (IoT) for over 20 years. From connected vehicles to networking, we seek our solutions to be used globally and become an indispensable part of any business. By setting new trends, we inspire our partners to change the world and use the most advanced technologies in the market.

We are constantly growing and looking for an organized IoT Solutions Engineering Specialist to join our team in São Paulo, SP.

In this role, you will:

  • Work with various Teltonika Telematics-manufactured GNSS tracking devices that embed technologies such as Bluetooth, CANbus, RS232/RS485, and 1-Wire
  • Propose different ways on how to incorporate our devices for various use cases
  • Be responsible for arranging technical tasks for custom development projects and coordinating solution release to clients
  • Troubleshoot, provide assistance, and consult clients via a dedicated ticketing system or online meetings/chats if they are needed
  • Communicate with global international corporations that provide car sharing, rental, fleet management solutions and various other companies from different vehicle telematics fields
  • Cooperate with R&D, quality assurance and project management teams to ensure the maintenance of the projects and that solutions reach the clients on time
  • Have an opportunity to go on business trips to visit clients and help them directly implement Teltonika devices into their business use cases.
  • Guide colleagues and customers by preparing wiki documentation or training

What we expect of you:

  • Great communication skills, are capable of fluently speaking and writing in English (proficiency in other languages will be considered as an advantage)
  • Telecommunications, electronics, informatics, engineering education or previous work experience in technical or engineering fields
  • Passion for providing help to others, caring, willing to grow and enrich your technological know-how
  • Analytical and creative thinking and mindset for problem-solving and troubleshooting
  • Understanding or basic knowledge of telecommunication technologies (2G, GPRS, 3G, 4G), CANbus, BLE
  • Knowledge or work experience working with ticketing-based platforms (Jira, GitLab, OpenProject, ServiceDesk) (this will be considered as an advantage)
  • Experience in customer service (this will be considered as an advantage)

What we offer:

  • Salary: We appreciate everyone's efforts and experiences, so we offer an attractive salary matching your skillset and field expertise.
  • Career: Great opportunities to grow in a strong and rapidly expanding company.
  • Work model: Hybrid (4 days in person and one remote)
  • Catering benefits: Cartão Caju (Vale Refeição of R$35 per working days + Saldo Livre of R$750 monthly + R$09 per working day), coffee and fruits provided in the office;
  • Health and Well-being Benefits: TotalPass, SESC membership, healthcare, dental care, and life insurance.
  • Teambuilding: regular office celebrations and events that help us to get to know each other better.
  • Caring and supportive team: we constantly seek for our employees to have better leadership while regularly sending our managers to external coaching sessions, conducting annual employee engagement surveys, and other management and HRD initiatives to help our employees overcome bottlenecks and challenges.

Teltonika aspires to become one of the global leaders in providing unique IoT solutions that contribute to making people's lives easier. Since 1998, we have gained considerable experience and competence in electronics development and production. Today, our areas of expertise include telematics, networking, telemedicine, EV charging, and electronics manufacturing. While proactively searching for new ideas and ways to create more value for our clients, we also hope to create a better future for our employees and the communities we operate in. Our organizational culture is based on mutual trust and respect as well as creating synergy with our employees and clients.

title: Technical Localization Specialist
description:
Technical Localization Consultant | Short-Term Contract (100% Remote – Brazil)

Fluent English required | 20h/week for 8 weeks

We're looking for an experienced Technical Localization Consultant to support a short-term, high-impact project focused on auditing and optimizing our end-to-end localization pipeline and Translation Management System (TMS).

This is a strategic, hands-on consulting role, ideal for someone who enjoys diving deep into systems, identifying bottlenecks, and proposing scalable, future-proof solutions.

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Commitment: 20 hours/week for 8 weeks

Compensation: Highly competitive, paid according to the right match. We have no fixed salary range and are open to market-aligned expectations.

What you'll do

Pipeline Audit & Optimization

  • Conduct a deep technical audit of the full localization pipeline (CMS, repositories, integrations, internal tools).
  • Assess internationalization (i18n) practices across product architecture and codebases, identifying technical debt and risks.
  • Interview stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Design, and Localization to map dependencies and pain points.
  • Deliver an executive-ready audit report with clear findings, ROI analysis, and strategic recommendations (including potential TMS upgrades or changes).

TMS Evaluation & Recommendation

  • Define technical and operational requirements for a new TMS alongside the Localization Manager.
  • Technically evaluate and compare modern TMS platforms (POCs included).
  • Recommend the best-fit TMS based on scalability, integrations, and implementation complexity.

What we're looking for

  • 5–7+ years of experience as a Technical Localization Consultant, Localization Engineer, or similar role.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in internationalization (i18n) best practices:
  • Pseudo-localization, pluralization, RTL/BiDi text, date/time formats.
  • High-volume content and non-product localization (marketing, support, legal, policy, etc.).
  • Deep experience with modern cloud-based TMS platforms (e.g. Smartling, Phrase, Lokalise, XTM), including migrations.
  • Solid technical background:
  • API integrations (REST / GraphQL)
  • Git & CI/CD pipelines
  • Localization formats (JSON, XLIFF, Gettext, Android XML, iOS Strings)
  • Python and/or Go
  • LitElement familiarity is a plus
  • Strong business acumen — able to translate technical findings into clear, ROI-driven recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

Why join?

  • Short-term, focused project with high strategic visibility
  • Full autonomy and trust
  • Competitive compensation with flexibility on rates
  • Fully remote, Brazil-based

title: Técnico Eletromecânico de Manutenção I
description:
Sobre Phibro Animal Health Corporation

A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.

As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.

A posição de Técnico Eletromecânico de Manutenção I é um componente importante de nosso time de Engenharia localizado em Guarulhos - SP.

Detalhes de posição

Executar serviços gerais de manutenção em equipamentos elétricos e mecânicos.

RESPONSABILIDADES CHAVE

  • Instalar/substituir equipamentos na planta como: Bombas (Hidráulicas; pneumáticas; diafragma, centrífugas, lóbulos e etc.). Válvulas (esfera, globo, agulha, gaveta).
  • Abertura de disjuntores para uma manutenção segura.
  • Diagnosticar possíveis problemas elétricos fora do horário administrativo.
  • Instalar/substituir itens de seccionadoras, disjuntores, inversores, chaves de distribuição, cabos, fios.
  • Examinar máquinas, equipamentos e instalações elétricas, de acordo com especificações técnicas e utilizando equipamentos adequados para medições, análises.
  • Realizar manutenções preventivas e corretivas nos equipamentos industriais da planta, como Caldeiras, compressores, lavadores de Gases, filtros,ventiladores, eixos,centrífugas e motores.
  • Identificar origem de problemas como desgaste de materiais, fadiga, quebras, deformações por impacto em periféricos como (mancais, rolamentos, polias, juntas, guarnições, agitadores, selos mecânicos, eixos) e, providenciar as medidas necessárias para solucionar os problemas e fatos ocorridos.
  • Efetuar ligações seguras de alimentação elétrica em equipamentos e itens prediais como lâmpadas, tomadas.
  • Zelar pela conservação dos materiais e equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo a manutenção de limpeza, organização e conservação do local de trabalho, observando também as normas de segurança do trabalho e seguindo as instruções conforme as atividades desenvolvidas e treinamentos internos.
